trip.title: Japan Honeymoon
trip.notes: PROVISIONAL autumn 2027 (late September–early October, flights/dates TBD): Tokyo arrival days 1–2; flight Haneda–Asahikawa day 3; Hokkaido Asahidake/Biei/Jozankei/Noboribetsu days 3–6; fly New Chitose–Osaka and transfer Kyoto day 7; Kyoto Nijo Castle/Gion day 8, Kifune day 9, Kyoto-based Osaka day trip (Osaka Castle/Tempozan/Dotonbori) day 10, Kyoto-based Himeji Castle day trip day 11 (Hikone Castle alternative); shinkansen to Tokyo day 12, Shinjuku optional evening; Mitaka/Nakano/Shibuya day 13, depart Tokyo day 14. Dates, hotel nights and all reservations unconfirmed. Several days are ambitious; allow relaxed alternatives. Kaiyukan, Hikone, Minakami, Lake Toya and alternative Hokkaido ryokan/Niseko remain optional and unscheduled. Lines on map connect schematic route waypoints and airport legs rather than real transit shapes.

days.title: Arrive in Tokyo
days.description: Arrive, check in and recover from the international flight.

days.title: East Tokyo
days.description: Asakusa/Senso-ji and Cafe Capyba in Sumida (reservation dependent).

days.title: Fly to Hokkaido · Asahidake
days.description: Fly Tokyo Haneda → Asahikawa Airport; continue to Asahidake if arrival time and ropeway/weather permit. Stay in the Asahikawa/Biei area.

days.title: Biei · Sapporo direction
days.description: Blue Pond and Biei scenery; travel toward Sapporo. Keep the previous hotel if transport works better.

days.title: Jozankei hot springs
days.description: Forest valley and a potential ryokan night in Jozankei. Suizantei is an unbooked lodging option.

days.title: Noboribetsu hot springs
days.description: Jigokudani trails and a potential ryokan night; Dai-ichi Takimotokan is one unbooked option.

days.title: Fly to Osaka · Kyoto
days.description: Transfer to New Chitose Airport; fly to Osaka Itami (or another suitable Osaka airport), then continue to Kyoto.

days.title: Kyoto castles & Gion
days.description: Visit Nijo Castle / Ninomaru Palace, then explore Gion and try Hikiniku to Kome (reservation dependent).

days.title: Kibune · Northern Kyoto
days.description: Kifune Shrine and the Kurama/Kibune valley, allowing time for transit.

days.title: Osaka day trip · Castle, bay & Dotonbori
days.description: From Kyoto, visit Osaka Castle in the morning, enjoy the Tempozan harbor waterfront in the afternoon, and finish by the Dotonbori canal after dark. Aquarium is an optional swap or extra half-day; return to Kyoto overnight.

days.title: Himeji Castle day trip
days.description: From Kyoto visit Himeji Castle and perhaps Kokoen Garden. Alternatively choose Hikone Castle near Lake Biwa or use this as a relaxed Kyoto day.

days.title: Shinkansen to Tokyo · Akihabara
days.description: Return to Tokyo from Kyoto; Jimbocho and Akihabara, with Shinjuku nightlife as an optional evening visit if energy permits.

days.title: West Tokyo · Ghibli, Nakano & Shibuya
days.description: Ghibli Museum timed entry, Nakano Broadway and Shibuya Crossing/Nintendo TOKYO later in the day. This is a full day; adjust around museum tickets.

days.title: Depart Tokyo
days.description: Fly home; leave a generous airport transfer buffer.

destinations.name: Hikiniku to Kome (Kyoto)
destinations.notes: Charcoal-grilled Japanese beef hamburg steaks with rice. Closed Wednesdays. Advance paid online registration or same-day in-person registration around 9 AM; book when Kyoto dates are decided.

destinations.name: Cafe Capyba (Hikifune)
destinations.notes: Capybara interaction café near Hikifune Station. Advance reservation required; bookings open 2 weeks ahead. Usually closed Wednesday and Thursday. Group with Tokyo sightseeing, potentially Sumida/Asakusa.

destinations.name: Kifune Shrine (Kibune Shrine)
destinations.notes: Scenic water-deity shrine north of central Kyoto, famous for red lantern-lined stone steps and forest setting. Allow substantial additional travel time from central Kyoto; consider combining with Kurama/Kibune area. Coordinates approximate; verify before final routing.

destinations.name: Takaragawa Onsen Osenkaku
destinations.address: 1899 Fujiwara, Minakami, Tone District, Gunma 379-1721, Japan
destinations.notes: Suggested one-night traditional ryokan stay, not booked. Riverside open-air baths; mixed bathing areas use provided bathing garments. From Tokyo take Joetsu Shinkansen to Jomo-Kogen (~70 min), then prebook overnight-guest shuttle or use local buses. Potential Tokyo-area excursion; do not assume it is directly en route to Kyoto. Confirm shuttle schedule, availability, bath policies and rates for travel dates.

destinations.name: Ghibli Museum, Mitaka
destinations.notes: Advance timed-entry ticket required; no tickets sold at museum. International ticket releases are typically on the 10th of the preceding month at 10:00 JST; verify current rules when dates are set. Pair with Inokashira Park/Kichijoji; west of central Tokyo, not near Sumida.

destinations.name: Akihabara Electric Town
destinations.notes: Retro Nintendo games, electronics, anime merchandise, miniature and figure shops. Half-day minimum.

destinations.name: Shinjuku sightseeing and nightlife
destinations.notes: Explore Omoide Yokocho, Kabukicho and Golden Gai in the evening. Pin represents Shinjuku Station area; individual stops can be added later.

destinations.name: Nakano Broadway
destinations.notes: Vintage anime, manga, collectibles and specialty hobby shops. Pair with Ghibli Museum/Mitaka if timing permits.

destinations.name: Jimbocho Book Town
destinations.notes: Used bookstores, specialty manga, art and illustration books. Convenient with Akihabara.

destinations.name: Senso-ji Temple (Asakusa)
destinations.notes: Historic Tokyo temple and Nakamise shopping street. Group with Cafe Capyba in Sumida.

destinations.name: Mount Asahidake / Daisetsuzan
destinations.notes: Alpine autumn colors often peak in September; weather, ropeway and trails can be affected by early snow. Requires substantial travel from Sapporo; consider Asahikawa/Biei base. Approximate mountain-area pin.

destinations.name: Shirogane Blue Pond
destinations.notes: Turquoise-blue pond and larches, often colorful in October. Combine with Biei countryside and nearby Shirogane Onsen.

destinations.name: Jozankei Onsen autumn valley
destinations.notes: Forested hot spring valley southwest of Sapporo, particularly attractive in early to mid October. Could be a one-night ryokan stop.

destinations.name: Noboribetsu Jigokudani (Hell Valley)
destinations.notes: Steaming volcanic valley and forest trails; pair with a Noboribetsu onsen overnight. Typical foliage mid to late October.

destinations.name: Lake Toya
destinations.notes: Caldera lake and lakeside onsen scenery. Could pair with Noboribetsu on a southwestern Hokkaido loop. Pin indicates lakeside town area.

destinations.name: Zaborin (Niseko)
destinations.notes: Luxury honeymoon splurge candidate, 1–2 nights; private onsen baths in suites. Not booked. Verify rates, availability, exact location and transport.

destinations.name: Dai-ichi Takimotokan
destinations.notes: Large traditional mineral bath complex near Hell Valley. One-night option; not booked.

destinations.name: Jozankei Daiichi Hotel Suizantei
destinations.notes: Upscale ryokan option in Jozankei autumn valley, 1–2 nights; not booked.

destinations.name: Shibuya & Scramble Crossing
destinations.notes: Explore the famous Scramble Crossing, Hachiko and Shibuya shopping streets. Pair with nearby Nintendo TOKYO at Shibuya PARCO. Late afternoon / evening best for atmosphere.

destinations.name: Nintendo TOKYO (Shibuya PARCO)
destinations.address: Shibuya PARCO 6F, 15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya City, Tokyo
destinations.notes: Official Nintendo store on 6F of Shibuya PARCO, next to Pokemon Center Shibuya and other game/anime retailers. Easily combined with Shibuya Crossing. Visit timing and crowd controls TBD.

destinations.name: Dotonbori / Tombori Riverwalk
destinations.notes: Famous neon-lit canal promenade, Glico sign and Osaka street food. Ideal evening finish to a Kyoto-based Osaka day trip. Optional 20-minute Tombori river cruise.

destinations.name: Tempozan Harbor Village (Osaka Bay)
destinations.notes: Waterfront promenade, views over Osaka Bay, giant Ferris wheel, harbor cruises and nearby Kaiyukan aquarium. Osakako Station on Chuo Line. Allow additional 2–3h if entering aquarium.

destinations.name: Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan
destinations.notes: Optional attraction inside Tempozan area; whale sharks and multi-story Pacific Ocean exhibits. Would require extra hours on Osaka day and possibly dropping another stop; left unscheduled.

destinations.name: Osaka Castle
destinations.notes: Famous historical castle site, reconstructed 1931 concrete keep containing Toyotomi Hideyoshi-era history museum, substantial original-looking stonework and moats, large park. Day 10 morning; allow time for transit to Tempozan.

destinations.name: Nijo Castle
destinations.notes: Historic Tokugawa shoguns' Kyoto residence; original palace buildings with nightingale floors, painted screens, moat and gardens. Day 8 before Gion/Hikiniku to Kome.

destinations.name: Himeji Castle
destinations.notes: UNESCO World Heritage original wooden castle, major Sengoku / early Edo fortifications. Recommended day trip from Kyoto; can combine with nearby Koko-en Garden. Day 11 is provisional and may be swapped for Hikone or a slower Kyoto day.

destinations.name: Hikone Castle (Lake Biwa)
destinations.notes: Alternative to Himeji day trip, nearer Kyoto on Lake Biwa. One of five original castle keeps classified as a National Treasure. Pair with Genkyuen Garden. Not scheduled to avoid overpacking day 11.
